priority_rules.condition: An active sensor has reliability_score at least 0.90, excursion_minutes is at least 120, and observed_max_c exceeds allowed_max_c by at least 5.0 C.
An active sensor has reliability_score at least 0.90 and either excursion_minutes is 60 to 119 or the threshold exceedance is 3.0 to 4.9 C.
An active reliable sensor reports an excursion below the P1 and P2 thresholds.
The joined sensor is inactive, calibration is not current, or reliability_score is below 0.90.

ordering_rules: Within a tier, order by excursion_minutes descending, then threshold exceedance descending, then delivery age descending.
Depot location is an operational label and is not a severity input.
action_boundary: Produce an inspection-priority report only. Do not update shipment or distribution status in the database.
